name: ParkingTicket
description: Primary entity capturing all details of a parking violation including vehicle information, violation details, location, timestamps, fine amount, and current status throughout its lifecycle

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the parking ticket

fields.name: ticketNumber
fields.description: Human-readable ticket number for reference and tracking

fields.name: licensePlate
fields.description: Vehicle license plate number

fields.name: violationType
fields.description: Type of parking violation (e.g., expired meter, no parking zone, fire hydrant)

fields.name: violationLocation
fields.description: Address or location where the violation occurred

fields.name: violationDate
fields.description: Date and time when the violation occurred

fields.name: fineAmount
fields.description: Amount of the fine in dollars

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (e.g., issued, paid, appealed, dismissed, overdue)

name: Officer
description: Parking enforcement officer information including identification, contact details, and assignment data

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the officer record

fields.name: badgeNumber
fields.description: Official badge number for the enforcement officer

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Officer's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Officer's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Officer's official email address

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department or division assignment

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current employment status (active, inactive, suspended)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when officer record was created

relationships.description: Officer can issue multiple parking tickets

name: ViolationType
description: Lookup entity containing predefined violation categories, descriptions, and default fine amounts for consistent ticket issuance

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the violation type

fields.name: code
fields.description: Short alphanumeric code for the violation (e.g., 'NO-PARK-01', 'EXP-METER')

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the violation type (e.g., 'Expired Meter', 'No Parking Zone')

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the violation and when it applies

fields.name: defaultFineAmount
fields.description: Default fine amount in dollars for this violation type

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this violation type is currently active and can be issued

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the violation type was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the violation type was last updated

constraints.uniqueCode: code must be unique across all violation types

name: Administrator
description: Entity representing administrative personnel who process payments and review appeals

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the administrator

fields.name: adminId
fields.description: Employee/badge ID for the administrator

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Administrator's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Administrator's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Administrator's email address for notifications and login

fields.name: role
fields.description: Administrative role (e.g., PaymentProcessor, AppealReviewer, Supervisor)

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department assignment (e.g., Finance, Appeals, Administration)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current employment status (active, inactive, suspended)

name: AuditLog
description: Tracks all significant system actions and events for compliance, security auditing, and accountability purposes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity affected (e.g., ParkingTicket, Payment, Appeal)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: Unique identifier of the affected entity

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action performed (e.g., CREATED, UPDATED, DELETED, STATUS_CHANGED, PAYMENT_PROCESSED)

fields.name: performedBy
fields.description: ID of user who performed the action (Officer, Administrator, or system)

fields.name: performedByRole
fields.description: Role of the user performing the action (Officer, Administrator, System, Citizen)

fields.name: changes
fields.description: JSON object containing before/after values of changed fields

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the action occurred

name: Payment
description: Entity storing payment transaction information for parking tickets including transaction details, payment method, amounts, and status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being paid

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: Unique transaction identifier from payment gateway

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in dollars

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method of payment (credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online)

fields.name: paymentStatus
fields.description: Current status of payment (pending, completed, failed, refunded)

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.description: Timestamp when payment was processed

fields.name: receiptNumber
fields.description: Unique receipt number for the transaction

relationships.description: Links payment to the parking ticket being paid

paymentMethod.description: Payment method must be one of the allowed types

paymentStatus.description: Payment status must be one of the defined states

name: Appeal
description: Manages ticket appeal submissions and administrative review decisions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the appeal

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being appealed

fields.name: appealReason
fields.description: Category or reason code for the appeal (e.g., 'incorrect_location', 'medical_emergency', 'meter_malfunction')

fields.name: appealDescription
fields.description: Detailed explanation provided by the violator for the appeal

fields.name: supportingDocuments
fields.description: Array of file URLs or document references submitted as evidence

fields.name: appealStatus
fields.description: Current status of the appeal (e.g., 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'denied')

fields.name: appealDecision
fields.description: Final decision on the appeal ('approved', 'denied', 'partially_approved')

fields.name: reviewerId
fields.description: Reference to the administrator who reviewed the appeal

relationships.description: Each appeal is associated with one parking ticket
Each appeal is reviewed by one administrator

name: Notification
description: Tracks all system notifications sent to users via email or SMS including ticket notifications, payment reminders, and appeal updates

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket associated with this notification

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address of the notification recipient

fields.name: recipientPhone
fields.description: Phone number of the notification recipient for SMS delivery

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (ticket_issued, payment_reminder, appeal_update, payment_confirmation)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Delivery channel used (email, sms)

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Subject line or title of the notification

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Current delivery status (pending, sent, delivered, failed)

relationships.description: Links notification to the associated parking ticket

constraints.recipientRequired: At least one of recipientEmail or recipientPhone must be provided

name: Receipt
description: Stores generated payment receipt information for paid parking tickets including receipt content, format, and generation timestamp

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the receipt

fields.name: paymentId
fields.description: Reference to the associated payment transaction

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket that was paid

fields.name: receiptNumber
fields.description: Human-readable unique receipt number for reference

fields.name: receiptContent
fields.description: Full content of the receipt including payment details and ticket information

fields.name: format
fields.description: Format of the receipt (PDF, HTML, JSON)

fields.name: generatedDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the receipt was generated

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Record creation timestamp

relationships.description: Each receipt belongs to one payment transaction
Each receipt is associated with one parking ticket

constraints.uniqueReceiptNumber: receiptNumber must be unique across all receipts
constraints.validFormat: format must be one of: PDF, HTML, JSON
